name: Essential Eight
issuing_body: Australian Signals Directorate, Australian Cyber Security Centre
notice: Requirements are quoted from the ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model, published under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence (© Commonwealth of Australia). Each mitigation strategy has a control per maturity level; assess the controls for the target maturity level and mark the others not applicable.

control_flags.type: ml1, ml2 or ml3: the maturity level whose requirements the control holds.

scoring.summary: Percentage of applicable strategy levels implemented, with partial counting as half. ASD measures maturity per strategy: a strategy is at a maturity level only when every requirement of that level is met. This percentage is an HCG readiness measure.

rules.summary: A strategy reaches a maturity level only when every requirement for that level is implemented.
rules.cite: HCG convention, consistent with the maturity model

rules.summary: Organisations choose a target maturity level based on the tradecraft and targeting they aim to mitigate; only the controls for that level apply and the others are marked not applicable.
rules.quote: can be used to help determine a target maturity level to implement.

rules.summary: Each maturity level's requirements are listed in full in its own appendix, so a level is assessed on its own list.
rules.cite: Essential Eight maturity model, Requirements for each maturity level
rules.quote: Requirements for Maturity Level One through to Maturity Level Three are outlined in Appendices A to C.

rules.summary: A partially implemented strategy level counts as half. This is an HCG convention.

glossary.definition: ASD's eight prioritised mitigation strategies: patch applications, patch operating systems, multi-factor authentication, restrict administrative privileges, application control, restrict Microsoft Office macros, user application hardening and regular backups.
Maturity Level One to Three, each aimed at mitigating a higher level of adversary tradecraft and targeting; Maturity Level Zero means weaknesses remain.
